tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dngos grub gling du dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal gyi 'bur sku bzhengs pa'i byin rten gzungs bzhugs tho// swasti/ chu sprel zla tshes la dpal sa skya'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa'i thos su tshoms dmar steng 'og mgon khang dngos grub gling dang bcas par nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bu dang / khyad par dngos grub gling du sngon dus kyi bris 'bur byin can rnams nang bzhugs kyi dkar bdud lcam dral lder bzo bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs tshul la/ dbu gzungs sa skya'i gdung rabs/ yang phur gyi dbang brgyud/ rtsa dum gyi lung brgyud/ lam zab kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi/ bdag med ma/ gur rigs bsdus/ saṃ pu ṭa dus 'khor/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/ 'jigs byed sa lugs/ kun rig a ra pa tsa na lha lnga/ tshe dpag med lha dgu/ sems bskyed dbu lugs/ so thar sdom brgyud/ gur zhal gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa rnams so so'i kha skong 'dod gsol bcas la saṃ ṭa dus 'khor de snga dbang ma thob pas kha skong gdan sa'i par ma bzhin dang / gzhan so so'i kha skong tshang ma rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bar/ bar gzungs la rgyud sde bzhi yi gzungs dang / chos skyong gur zhal rnams kyi gzungs rnams las/ yi dam gyi gzungs sngags gong gsal yongs rdzogs tshar bco lnga re/ chos skyong gi sngags tshar bdun/ dkar mo ba rang gi srog snying chig stong brgya med bdun cu don gsum/ mjug 'dod gsol rgyas pa bcas/ bdud rgyal gyi srog snying chig stong brgya med drug cu re gcig 'dod gsol bcas/ pad gzungs la rnam sras/ mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu/ dkon mchog gsum dang phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis rnams tshar gnyis/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo gsum rnams sku so sor cha tshang re bzhugs pa dang / byin rten la dkar mo ba'i dbur slob dpon rin po che'i gter sku 'khrul med/

bdud rgyal gyi dbur rdo rje phur pa'i par sku la gzungs bzhugs tshul ni/ dbu zhabs bar gsum gyi gzungs bsdus/ gong ma lnga'i dbu skra dang na bza'/ rje phag mo grub pa'i na bza'/ bla ma gong ma na rim gdung la kun dga' bsod nams kyi sku gcig thang stong rgyal po'i sku gcig 'jigs byed sku gcig de rnams par du btab pa/ yang theg chen pur sha gong ma kha shas kyi na bza' dngos su gsal ba/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i na bza' dang zhabs chags dum bu/ rje tshar pa'i dbu skra na bza'/ sgar chen na bza'/ thang stong rgyal po'i na bza'/ kun dga' bsod nams kyi dbu skra dang shang mtshal/ phyag zhabs gnyis kyi sen mo'i dum bu/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi na bza' dang dbu skra/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams dbang phyug gi dbu skra dang na bza'/ mgrin par ril bu khyad 'phags rnams bzhugs pa'i byin brlabs can/ khyung po'i thugs las byon pa'i ring bsrel nged rang dbus la phyin skabs bye tshogs na rten mchod mjal dus lag mthil dang spang por su lnga babs pa'i gras nas re re byang sems chos 'phags dang ston pa'i chibs ngang pa gser ldan gnyis kyi tshems dum bu/ slob dpon rin po che dang ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi phyag bris gter shog gi dum bu/ jo bo'i phyag tsha'i nang bzhugs tsha gzungs 'byin par ma/ ring bsrel can phyag rjes yod pa'i dum bu/ sa paṇa gyi gdung thal/ 'phags pa rin po che'i dbu bsnyel dum bu/ 'u yug gi dbu skra/ chos rje bla ma'i na bza'/ theg chen rin po che'i pur sha shar rgyan ye rgyal gyi pur ras/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi pur thal sku chos/ rgyal tshab dam pa'i sku skegs dbu skra na bza'/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi chos gos/ shar chen shes 'gyur pur rus/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi chags lh+wam yu ba/ rdo rings pa'i zhun thigs/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku skegs/

sgo rum pa'i pur rus/ sangs rgyas seng ge'i pur ras pur rus zhun thigs/ tshar chen gyi dbu thod pur rus dbu lo/ thugs dam gtor ma/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi pur rus ril bu/ gzhon nu blo gros kyi sku skegs pur tsha dbu dom/ 'gyur med bde chen gyi dbu lo/ ta ra ba'i pur rus/ bsod nams dbang po'i tshems/ ring bsrel can gyi dum bu/ dbu lo/ dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi pur rus/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi pur rus/ phyag 'phreng / klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i pur rus/ thar rtse sa paṇa gyi dbu lo/ yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi pur rus/ dbang phyug rab brtan gyi sku skegs dbu lo gzim thul/ spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan can gyi dbu lo/ ngag dbang chos grags kyi dbu lo gsang chen tshems dum/ kun dga' dbang rgyal gyi dbu lo/ sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dum pur rus dbu lo phyag sen phyag 'phreng / shangs phyis/ phur dar rnams kyi dum bu/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug gi gdung 'dam la rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrol ma/ gdung thal/ zhabs sen/ bka' 'gyur ba'i gdung rus/ ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi gdung rus/ ka spe ba'i tshems ring bsrel can/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi gdung 'dam la rje nyid kyi sku/ dbu zhwa/ pur rus/ dbu lo/ pur thal/ tshul khrims dpal bzang gi gdung thal/ yab rje'i pur chab zegs 'dam/ na bza' dbu lo/ gdung 'dam la/ sa paṇa/ maṅga'i mtshan/ rje nyid/ 'od dpag med/ rnam 'joms/ sgrol ma/ 'jigs byed/ mkha' spyod ma'i sku rnams dang / dam rdzas kyi sātstsha/ tshe dpag med/ yang rje btsun gong ma lnga/ na bza' brag phug pa/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / sems dpa' chen po/ bdag chen rin po che/ zhwa lu mkhyen rab/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ zhwa lu lo chen/ sa lo/ kun dga' grol mchog tshar chen/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum/ a mes zhabs/ bsod nams dbang phyug

maṅga'i mtshan can/ bsod nams rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ tshul khrims dpal bzang / bsod nams bzang po/ yab rje dam pa rnams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ sgo rum ye shes mgon po'i zhal sgo nas bdud rtsi ril bu rlon pa yab rjes bzhes pa'i dum bu/ mgrin par yab rje'i stong rdo gnyis re/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i skye bdun a ma/ gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje'i bdud rtsi chos sman/ ma ṇi ril bu/ rdor sems thugs sgrub ril bu/ 'dus pa mdo'i gsang rdzas/ skye bdun ril bu rnams dang / maṅga'i mtshan can gyi bde gshegs kun 'dus ril bu/ ri bo rtse lnga nas byung rtswa kun bzang / sa sna rdo sna/ 'jam dbyangs sku mtshal ril bu/ tsā ri tsā gong tsā 'dra rdzong dkar mdun rgyab/ dri med kun ldan gyi bzhugs sa sogs nas skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi phyag zhabs rjes kyi sa sna rdo sna/ rtswa dum/ me tog shing sna sogs dang / khyad par dkar mo ba'i thugs kar sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam ma 'khrul med dngos grub gling na snga mo nas bzhugs pa'i dkar mo nyid kyi sku mtho gang lhag tsam/ de nyid dar zab kyi na bza' bcas/ theg chen pur ras la sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rje nyid chung ngu'i dus stag tshang du gzigs snang la ji ltar shar ba bzhin gyi/ sa paṇa seng zhon ma'i sku yi bkod pa la/ lha phran steng dbus lo chen rin bzang / g.yas brag steng pa/ g.yon mal lo/ 'og dbus sa lo nyid/ g.yas bram gzugs/ g.yon nor skyong yab yum gyi sku bcas yod pa'i chung ngu gcig dang / bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gi thugs dam ma yin nam snyam pa'i dkar mo ba hang tshon can/ lha phran la ku ru kulle/ tshogs bdag dzam ser rnams yod pa zhig dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos dpal chen pho brang du sgrub pa mdzad dus dkar bdud zhal gzigs nas thang sku la thim pa'i thugs snang khyad par can byung ba de nyid la steng nas sa lo sngags 'chang dkar mo ba gtso rkyang gi sku ngo mtshar can/

bla ma gong ma'i na bza' sku 'gag bur zhabs lh+wam gyi yu ba/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i rdzas rnams gang 'dzoms bcas dang / bdud rgyal gyi thugs khar lcags rdor gter ma rtse lnga la srog snying 'dod gsol bcas dkris pa/ sngags 'chang chen pos dpal chen pho brang du phur bsnyen mdzad tshe gzigs snang ji ltar shar ba bzhin sgo ma bzhi/ phur srung bcu gnyis rnams sku yi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs dar kha dog bzhi la 'bri bar mdzad pa byin brlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i de nyid bcas mdor na lcam dral gnyis la gzungs gzhug khyad cung zad ma gtogs gong bkod tshang ma cha tshang re bzhugs shing / gdung tsha ma gtogs gzhan byin rlabs kun bdud rtsi ril bu'i 'dam dang gnyis su med par bsres nas bzhugs su gsol ba'i 'dod gsol ni/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ snyan nas snyan brgyud rim par byon pa'i grub thob rig 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams dang / 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs/ padma gsung gi lha tshogs/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi lha tshogs/ phrin las phur bu'i lha tshogs/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum/ sprul pa'i khra thabs nyi shu/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis/ bstan srung dkar bdud lcam dral sogs bslu ba med pa'i ye shes sems dpa'i sa skya pa rig pa 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams dang /

dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug dang / lung dang / rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dbus gtsang khams gsum stod mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i rgyal po g.yog 'bangs/ che btsun grwa slob/ de dag la 'go ba'i lha srung dang bcas pa rang gi ngang gis dbang du 'dus nas/ sa skya'i bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spyir bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams dang / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud sde dang bcas pa la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i log 'dren thams cad myur du tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du 'byung zhing / de rnams kyang chos srid kyi 'phrin las yar 'phel du gyur nas/ dpal ldan 'phags pa'i rnam thar dang rjes su mthun par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa/ bstan 'dzin rnams sku tshe brtan pa/ 'jig rten bde zhing skyid pa sogs 'phral dang yun du rang gzhan kun la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang ldan par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag dpon slob rnams dus 'dir tshe ring nad med chos 'byor 'phel ba'i ngang nas/ bstan pa'i bya ba sogs yid la re ba thams cad mthar phyin nas/ phyi ma dpon slob kun kyang lhan cig tu zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bslu med dkon mchog rnams kyi thugs rjes bsam pa'i don 'di thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar gyur cig de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ka lya na wardhantu/ sarba dā oṃ/ zhes sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' bsod nams kyi phur thang gser ma'i rgyab gzungs kyi mthar gnang 'dug pa bzhin/

nged rang spun gyi ming bsgyur te bzhugs su gsol ba'i dkar chag 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud rgyal gyi 'bur sku bzhengs pa'i byin rten gzungs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
